My dear [Miss Wilcox](/person/1517),
I hope your [mother](/person/2030) is improving in spite of the cold winds and that you are beginning to think of turning your face to the South, now that Easter is so near. It will be a great pleasure to see you, and I hope you will soon be able to mention a day.
Do tell me if you know the answer to [Mr Dodgson](/person/261)’s Acrostic in Phantasmagoria[^2] I am sure that the second shadow is Commemoration but nobody can make out the first

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^2]: Margaret Wilcox was a cousin and close friend of Lewis Carroll\'s.
